reserveReview.rationale: The live USD.AI reserve index observed on 2026-09-21 identifies 63.01098086% PYUSD and 36.98901914% across 20 share-bearing GPU loans. Published shares total 100%; seven entries without share weights are not assigned additional exposure. At Arbitrum block 507385839 (2026-09-21T08:35:24Z), PYUSD balanceOf(USDai) returned 307910381063423 base units, exactly matching the API amount normalized from 18 decimals to 307,910,381.063423 PYUSD. This review verifies the current issuer-disclosed composition and liquid balance, not the off-chain GPU identity, appraisal, insurance, SPV structure, or loan enforceability. Loan values remain issuer-disclosed. Existing source keys and the serial-wrapper dependency treatment are retained.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai; this PYUSD slice is the look-through of the parent's backing. The PYUSD exposure is inherited through the reviewed serial wrapper edge to usdai-usd-ai (whose verified reserve envelope is 100% PYUSD) and is tracked on the parent asset, so the slice is not a separate parallel dependency link.

GPU infrastructure loans are private-credit positions, not tracked stablecoin dependencies. Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (Lane42Inverse), observed 2026-10-09T10:35:59Z: the current issuer reserve API publishes documentId, borrower, term in seconds, remaining amounts and share per loan. Borrower FAQ describes approximately 36-month amortization, while the overview describes 3-year principal amortization. Those descriptions do not establish a contractual maximum for every position in this September 21 reserve envelope. No maturityDaysMax, new weights or refreshed composition clock is inferred; current loan-term data requires a complete identity and gross-exposure reconciliation before a whole-slice observed-tenor bound can be admitted.
